FN-V1F3VVV-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 139
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 139 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Board of
Cosmetology and Barbering until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This
bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
